mapper.sql: a.id, a.student_id, a.kind, a.level, a.title, a.reason, a.amount, a.doc_no, a.granted_on, a.revoked_on, a.operator_id, a.created_at, a.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(o.real_name, ''), o.username) AS operator_name

FROM award_punishment a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = a.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users o ON o.id = a.operator_id

sql.if: AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.doc_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO award_punishment (student_id, kind, level, title, reason, amount, doc_no, granted_on, revoked_on, operator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{kind}, #{level}, #{title}, #{reason}, #{amount}, #{docNo}, #{grantedOn}, #{revokedOn}, #{operatorId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE award_punishment SET kind = #{kind}, level = #{level}, title = #{title}, reason = #{reason}, amount = #{amount}, doc_no = #{docNo}, granted_on = #{grantedOn}, revoked_on = #{revokedOn} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE award_punishment SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
